observation_summary: The unescape method incorrectly converted large numeric entity references into invalid characters instead of returning the original entity string.
reasoning_summary: The code failed to validate that the parsed numeric value of an XML entity reference fits within the range of a valid Java character (0xFFFF). When an entity like '&#12345678;' was provided, the parser attempted to convert the large integer into a character, resulting in an incorrect character representation or overflow behavior. The fix introduces a check to ensure the parsed integer does not exceed 0xFFFF, treating values outside this range as invalid entities, which correctly preserves the original string as expected.
